verdict.rationale: Marqeta's evidence shows an MCP server that lets customers plug their own AI agents into Marqeta's API (marqeta-docs-11, marqeta-docs-25, marqeta-probe-4), but this is customer-built agent access, not a built-in AI assistant living inside the Marqeta product that users can delegate tasks to. No evidence of an in-dashboard copilot or assistant feature exists in the pack.
